review_evidence: The unit contains 116 vendor/sail-riscv-zkvm-lean formal files, five scripts, and bench/DivBench.lean.

The vendor subtree is generated RISC-V semantic content and remains searchable; DivBench owns reusable machine-state, execution-tally, division/modulus reference, and candidate definitions and is retained.

Each selected script was inspected directly: two audit the Lean environment/axioms, one emits an already-retained guarded handler, one only #eval-prints an already-retained guest-image dump, and one performs a per-module axiom policy check.

rules.content_invariant: All mathematical and semantic objects referenced by these scripts remain in retained EvmAsm or vendored formal modules; removing these exact maintenance drivers cannot hide a unique EVM definition, statement, proof, or reusable semantic interface.
evidence: AxiomSweep and WitnessCandidates inspect compiled-environment trust/progress metadata; port_check_axioms checks module axiom policy.
emit_guarded_handler_driver imports and prints the retained guardedCleanRetHandlerProgram; GuestImageShapeDumpRun is only an import/open plus #eval of retained dump.
rules.rationale: The selected scripts are repository-maintenance audit or executable-driver tooling and do not own the EVM/RISC-V specifications or proofs they inspect or invoke.

summary: Reviewed the bench/scripts/vendor unit; retain the Sail-generated RISC-V semantics and the substantive division benchmark definitions, while excluding five project-audit/driver scripts.
